edges.reason: withdraw sends the entire contract balance directly to the caller-controlled msg.sender
reserveTokens mints reserved tokens to the caller msg.sender
mintGem mints newly purchased tokens to the caller msg.sender
onlyOwner compares the stored owner with the caller-controlled _msgSender()
withdraw executes the raw value transfer unsafe operation
the transfer pushes ether to msg.sender, which may be a reentrant contract
mintGem calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient after supply checks
reserveTokens calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient
reserveGems calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the arbitrary recipient
numberOfTokens parameter drives the mint loop and payment checks in mintGem
_to parameter is the mint recipient in reserveGems
_reserveAmount parameter controls the reserveGems mint loop bound
provenanceHash parameter is stored into VOG_PROVENANCE
baseURI_ parameter is stored into _baseURIExtended
tokenId parameter selects the metadata returned by tokenURI
gemPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) is compared to msg.value to validate payment
MAX_SUPPLY bounds total mintable supply in mintGem
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the reserveTokens mint loop
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the reserveGems mint loop
MAX_SUPPLY is the modulus applied to the block hash in calcStartingIndex
MAX_NFT_PURCHASE caps numberOfTokens in mintGem
saleIsActive gates whether mintGem can proceed
flipSaleState inverts the saleIsActive flag
startingIndex is written and sanity-checked in calcStartingIndex
startingIndexBlock provides the block hash source for the starting index
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock overwrites startingIndexBlock with block.number
reserveTokens initializes startingIndexBlock when it is still zero
reserveGems initializes startingIndexBlock when it is still zero
setProvenanceHash writes the provenance string state variable
_baseURI returns the stored _baseURIExtended value
setBaseURI writes the _baseURIExtended value
tokenURI reads the per-token URI from the _tokenURIs mapping
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the base prefix
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for the authorization check
onlyOwner gates flipSaleState to the contract owner
onlyOwner gates withdraw to the contract owner
onlyOwner gates reserveTokens to the contract owner
onlyOwner gates reserveGems to the contract owner
onlyOwner gates calcStartingIndex to the contract owner
onlyOwner gates setProvenanceHash to the contract owner
onlyOwner gates emergencySetStartingIndexBlock to the contract owner
onlyOwner gates setBaseURI to the contract owner
the balance local variable is the value forwarded by the transfer in withdraw
supply local variable seeds the reserveTokens mint indices
supply local variable seeds the reserveGems mint indices
the i loop counter drives the repeated _safeMint calls in mintGem
_tokenURI local variable is the per-token URI read in tokenURI
base local variable is the base URI used to build the token URI

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is only meaningful as the mint count argument of mintGem and can be merged into that function node
_to is the recipient argument used only by reserveGems and can be merged into that function node
_reserveAmount is the loop bound argument used only by reserveGems and can be merged into that function node
provenanceHash is the input argument written by setProvenanceHash and can be merged into that function node
baseURI_ is the input argument written by setBaseURI and can be merged into that function node
tokenId is the lookup argument used only by tokenURI and can be merged into that function node
balance_local only carries the amount sent by the transfer unsafe operation in withdraw
supply_local is the totalSupply snapshot used as the mint index base in reserveTokens
